description: Implementation of the CryptoHal class for Android DRM, managing cryptographic plugin interactions via AIDL and HIDL interfaces.

classes.name: CryptoHal
classes.description: Class managing cryptographic plugin interactions for Android DRM, supporting initialization, plugin creation/destruction, decryption, and logging.

methods.name: CryptoHal
methods.description: Constructor initializing AIDL and HIDL crypto interface pointers.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the crypto plugin is initialized properly.

methods.name: isCryptoSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a crypto scheme UUID is supported.

methods.name: createPlugin
methods.description: Creates a crypto plugin with specified UUID and data.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoderComponent
methods.description: Checks if a secure decoder component is required for a given MIME type.

methods.name: notifyResolution
methods.description: Notifies the plugin of display resolution changes.

methods.name: setMediaDrmSession
methods.description: Sets the Media DRM session ID.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption with specified key, IV, mode, pattern, source buffer, and sub-samples.

methods.name: setHeap
methods.description: Sets the memory heap for the plugin.

methods.name: unsetHeap
methods.description: Unsets the memory heap for the plugin.

methods.name: getLogMessages
methods.description: Retrieves log messages from the plugin.
